explanation: Q2 = -0.5 GeV^2 is not physically realizable for electroproduction ep -> e'p(eta). In single-photon exchange electron scattering, the exchanged virtual photon is space-like, so Q^2 (as used throughout eta/exclurad.F and defined in eta/spp.inc) must satisfy Q^2 >= 0; Q^2 = 0 is the real-photon (photoproduction) limit and negative values correspond to a time-like photon, which does not occur in this reaction. This is also reflected mechanically in the code: the EtaMAID-2023 hadronic amplitude grid used for the eta configuration (eta/mpintp.inc, NVAR1=101) is tabulated over Q^2 = 0-5 GeV^2 (var1_min = 0), so Q2 = -0.5 falls outside the interpolation table and would trigger the fatal out-of-range check in the spline interpolation routine (eta/exclurad.F ~line 4019-4026) before any radiative-correction calculation could proceed. The other requested kinematics (W = 1.7 GeV, well above the eta threshold W_thr ~ m_p + m_eta ~ 1.486 GeV; cos(theta*) = 0; phi* = 90 deg) are all individually valid, but the negative Q2 makes the overall kinematic point non-physical, so no input file was generated. To proceed, please supply a non-negative Q^2 (e.g. Q2 = 0.5 GeV^2, which is within the tabulated 0-5 GeV^2 range) and I will generate the corresponding EXCLURAD input file.
